history: Nanchang has 2,200 years of city history; the Tengwang Pavilion of 'sunset clouds fly with a lone duck' has been immortal for ages. The August 1st Uprising of 1927 fired here — the People's Army was born, so it is the 'Hero City'. Poyang Lake's migrating birds and the Haihunhou tomb's tons of gold stunned archaeologists.
foods: Clay-jar soup baked over charcoal — meat-patty and egg soup, fresh.
Mixed rice noodles with clay-jar soup — the golden breakfast pair.
Crisp wormwood shoots of Poyang Lake — a Jiangxi classic.
Fried golden and dusted with sugar — soft and chewy.
'One cup of oil, one of soy, one of wine.'
Wok-fried noodles for the night shift.
Lake crabs full of roe — an autumn exclusive.
scenes: First of the three great southern towers — 'sunset clouds and lone duck'.
Monument where the army's flag first rose.
A Han tomb with ten thousand relics and mountains of gold.
Thousand-year pagoda ringed by food streets.
China's largest freshwater lake — winter home of white cranes.
Nanchang's back garden — summer retreat by Yaohu Lake.
Asia's largest fountain cluster facing the Tengwang Pavilion.
Taoist master Xu Jing's sanctuary and heritage streets.
